responsibility: This file implements the pipeline scheduling model for Cavium Octeon, Octeon2, and Octeon3 processors. It models the dual-issue integer pipes, multiply unit, and Octeon3 floating-point unit, with distinct reservations for arithmetic, branches, loads/stores, HI/LO access, integer multiply/divide, condition moves, coprocessor transfers, and Octeon3 FP operations, allowing GCC to schedule code according to the evolving microarchitectural differences within the Octeon family.
